title: Free Shipping with No Min Spend @ Booktopia
body:
Deal: Free Shipping with No Min Spend @ Booktopia

[Elyxar] I haven't looked at prices of books in 10 years. Paperbacks are now $35… I'm glad I only do audiobooks now. I was thinking of getting rid of all my books but now I might put them in my will.
[OZKap] op shops are great for buying books, even the most expensive op shops the books are $5 max.
Plenty around here are $1 per book, but of course you pay with your time searching for them
[CoffeeBrowse] Plenty, the Bookbinder's Bargain, The Rose Bargain, Bargain So Bloody, The Dukes Mistletoe Bargain and even more, take your pick!
[OZKap] The expanse series 10%-36% off
Takeshi Kovacs trilogy (altered carbon) by Richard Morgan for $50 delivered is what I'd consider a bargain
Project hail mary $14.99 40% OFF
[RickyJ] You have great taste. The "Red Rising" series is another that you'll probably enjoy. It's my favourite so far but still waiting for the last book to be released.
[OZKap] Thanks, I've added it to the list to keep an eye on. If you haven't read it yet, Richard Morgan's Thin Air is set on Mars as well, same universe as Black Man but could be read standalone.
[Benoffie] Well, they are beating Amazon on the Metro series (I had to order a fluke sale from Amazon UK for the 33/34 double pack to get both sub $19)
2035 incoming it seems
[Selenium] Nice. Some books from my Amazon wishlist quite a bit cheaper here.
[Embaloo] Hmm prices on my wishlist items have gone up since this "sale" started. Worth Shopping around.
[bunny michael] I used to buy from Booktopia, but they went under and my money went down the drain.
